configuration.scope: exploratory fixed blending declared before full v4 results; no learned weights or outer test
configuration.policy: expected_gain_per_positive_predicted_extra_cost; strong iff ratio > threshold; ties weak

selection.quality_floor_reference: fixed strong model on development validation
selection.rule: minimum observed development call cost among feasible points; ties higher success then candidate ID then parameter
selection.fallback: fixed strong if no candidate meets the development quality floor
selection.interpretation: exploratory repeated development, not independent or confirmatory evidence
